partners.mechanism_chain: POLR3A (HGNC:9900) —DISRUPTS→ RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357); POLR3B (HGNC:9901) —DISRUPTS→ RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357); RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomyelination (HP:0011188); RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357) —LEADS_TO→ Demyelinating Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (HP:0003489); RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357) —LEADS_TO→ Oligodontia (HP:0000231); RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006357) —LEADS_TO→ Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HP:0000830). Mutations in POLR3A and POLR3B impair RNA Polymerase III transcription, a process crucial for the synthesis of various non-coding RNAs essential for cellular homeostasis, including tRNA and 5S rRNA. Dysregulation of RNA Polymerase III transcription impacts oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelination, leading to hypomyelination (Disease A) and demyelinating neuropathy (Disease B). The disruption also affects other developmental processes, contributing to oligodontia and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism observed in some patients with Disease A.

partners.diseaseBName: macrocephaly, acquired, with impaired intellectual development
partners.mechanism_chain: POLR3A (HGNC:9906) —DISRUPTS→ RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006366); RNA Polymerase III transcription (GO:0006366) —LEADS_TO→ Hypomyelinating leukodystrophy (HP:0031033); NFIB (HGNC:7771) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of neurogenesis and brain development (GO:0022407); Regulation of neurogenesis and brain development (GO:0022407) —LEADS_TO→ Macrocephaly (HP:0000256); Regulation of neurogenesis and brain development (GO:0022407) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired intellectual development (HP:0001263). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in NFIB disrupt pathways regulating neurogenesis and brain development, resulting in macrocephaly and impaired intellectual development.
